s.note: Beef frank, slow chilli, cheddar, onion.
s.how: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic. Add the chilli powder, cumin and tomatoes and simmer until thick. Grill the franks until blistered. Fill the toasted rolls and top with chilli, cheddar and raw onion.

s.n: Game-ball soft pretzels with beer cheese
s.note: Chewy salted pretzels, sharp cheddar dip.
s.how: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, a teaspoon of salt and the water and knead until smooth, then leave to double. Roll into 8 ropes and twist into pretzels. Boil each for 30 seconds in 2 litres of water with the bicarbonate of soda, then drain. Brush with egg, sprinkle with salt and bake at 220C until deep brown. Melt the butter, stir in the extra flour, whisk in the lager, then melt in the cheddar and mustard.

m.note: Smoky brisket, pickled onion, slaw, soft roll.
m.how: Rub the brisket with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and 2 teaspoons of salt. Sit it in a roasting dish with the stock, cover tightly and cook at 150C until it pulls apart. Meanwhile cover the onion with the vinegar and a pinch of sugar and salt to pickle, and toss the cabbage with the mayonnaise. Slice or pull the brisket, toss with the barbecue sauce and some pan juices. Pile into the rolls with slaw and pickled onion.

w.note: Shaved ice with cherry and lime syrups and condensed milk.
w.how: Simmer the cherries with half the sugar and 100ml water until syrupy, then strain and cool. Simmer the rest of the sugar with the lime zest and juice and 100ml water for 2 minutes, then cool. Shave or blitz the ice to snow in a strong blender. Pile into cups, pour over both syrups and drizzle with condensed milk.

d.note: Bourbon over ice, a twist of orange. Jimmy makes Joe spill his whiskey.
d.how: Put two big cubes in each of 4 tumblers and pour 60ml bourbon over. Twist a strip of orange peel over each and drop it in.
